==Acquisition==
*This mod can be purchased '''unranked''' from [[Baro Ki'Teer]] for {{cc|200,000}} and {{dc|280}}. Note however that Baro Ki'Teer's stock changes with each appearance, and may not have this item available at every time.

==Tips==
*Works particularly well with the {{Weapon|Kuva Hek}}, as it grants the gun an additional four rounds of ammunition and allows a quick succession of its heavy burst alt-fire shots.
*Works also well with the {{Weapon|Tigris}} shotgun series, allowing a quick fire of four rounds within a second and increasing overall DPS due to its fairly quick reload speed.

==Trivia==
*Primed Ammo Stock was an unintentionally released and briefly replaced all standard copies of {{M|Ammo Stock}} between {{ver|16.4}} and {{ver|16.4.1|fix}}, however aside from its Legendary rarity, the two mods were otherwise identical.
*When paired with {{M|Burdened Magazine}}, this mod allows the {{Weapon|Exergis}} to reach a magazine size of 3 without use of [[Riven Mods]].

{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Primary Merciless''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Primary_Weapon_Arcanes|Primary Arcane]] that on kill increases primary weapon damage for 4 seconds and stacks up to 12 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[reload speed]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
!Total at 12 stacks
! Reload Speed
|-
| 0 || 5% || 60% || -
|-
| 1 || 10% || 120%  || -
|-
| 2 || 15% || 180% || -
|-
| 3 || 20% || 240% || -
|-
| 4 || 25% || 300% || -
|-
| 5 || 30% || 360% || 30%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*'''Only''' weapon kills from the weapon with Primary Merciless counts for stacking this effect.
**Status kills count if the killing status was applied by the weapon with Merciless. 
**Lingering effects that deal damage (such as those from {{Weapon|Purgator 1}} or {{Weapon|Proboscis Cernos}}) usually count.
**Alt-fire modes usually count.
*Stacks of the buff are not shared between different weapons that have Primary Merciless equipped, such as primary [[Exalted Weapons]] and [[Archgun|Archguns]].
**Individual weapons have their own stacks which are stored and updated independently of other stacks of Primary Merciless. 
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
**After reaching the maximum 12 stacks, the buff will take 48 seconds to fully expire.
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Serration}}.

==Tips==
*Useful on weapons that can already kill groups of enemies quickly, such as most explosive weapons or weapons that chain between targets. Less useful on slow firing weapons that rely on status effects to kill their targets like single shot rifles.
*Can be compared to {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}}, which has an identical maximum damage bonus of 360%, but acquires stacks on [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot]] kills, requiring fewer total kills for upkeep, and which can last for a total of 72 seconds, rather than the 48 seconds of Merciless.

==Patch History==
{{Scrollbox/Article|
{{ver|32}}

{{ver|30.5}}
*Introduced.
}}

{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Primary Deadhead''' is a [[Arcane Enhancement#Primary_Weapon_Arcanes|Primary Arcane]] that on weak point kill increases primary weapon damage for 24 seconds and stacks up to 3 times. At max rank, it also passively increases [[Enemy Body Parts|headshot damage multiplier]] and reduces [[recoil]].

Can be sold for {{cc|1,000}}.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]]
! Damage per Stack
! Total at 3 stacks
! Headshot Multiplier
! Recoil
|-
| 0 || 20% || 60% || - || -
|-
| 1 || 40% || 120% || - || -
|-
| 2 || 60% || 180% || - || -
|-
| 3 || 80% || 240% || - || -
|-
| 4 || 100% || 300% || - || -
|-
| 5 || 120% || 360% || +30% || -50%
|}

{{Acquisition|Awarded for defeating [[Acolytes]] in [[The Steel Path]].}}

==Notes==
*The damage bonus stacks additively with other damage mods like {{M|Serration}}.
*When the buff times out, one stack is lost and the buff duration resets.
*Headshot bonus stacks additively with {{M|Target Acquired}}, innate headshot damage bonuses on weapons such as {{Weapon|Kuva Chakkhurr}}, and snipers with bonus headshot damage from scope bonuses.
**{{Weapon|Cernos Prime}}'s headshot bonus is unique and stacks multiplicatively with Primary Deadhead's headshot bonus.
*Kills from some status procs on the target's weak point do '''not''' count as a weak point kill.
**{{D|Electricity}} and {{D|Gas}} procs are able to trigger the effect when aimed at the head however, as they are able to land headshots themselves.
*'Precision' refers to direct hit weak points (not AoE).

==Tips==
*Can be used on weapons which normally have a 1.0x multiplier to headshots (such as the {{Weapon|Arca Plasmor}}/{{Weapon|Tenet Arca Plasmor}} and [[Update 32]] launchers such as the {{Weapon|Kuva Zarr}} and {{Weapon|Afentis}}) to give them a 1.3x headshot multiplier and actually provide a benefit.
*Since Electricity and Gas procs are able to independently land headshots, they benefit twice from the headshot multiplier bonus. Both of these procs will have 1.69x headshot damage from the bonus.

{{ArcaneBox}}
'''Primary Frostbite''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for primary weapons that increases primary weapon [[critical multiplier]] and [[multishot]] for 12 seconds when applying {{D|Cold}} procs.

==Effect==
{| class="emodtable"
|-
! [[Arcane Enhancement#Rank|Rank]] !! Critical Damage per Stack !! Max Critical Damage Stack !! Multishot per Stack !! Max Multishot Stack
|-
| 0 || 0.5% || 20% || 0.375% || 15%
|-
| 1 || 1% || 40% || 0.75% || 30%
|-
| 2 || 1.5% || 60% || 1.125% || 45%
|-
| 3 || 2% || 80% || 1.5% || 60%
|-
| 4 || 2.5% || 100% || 1.875% || 75%
|-
| 5 || 3% || 120% || 2.25% || 90%
|}

{{Acquisition|*Primary Frostbite can be obtained from [[Conjunction Survival]] [[Circulus]] on [[Lua]] as a [[Rotation]] C reward.
*Purchaseable from [[Archimedean Yonta]] for 15 {{Resource|Lua Thrax Plasm}} each, with a total of 315 for max rank.
*Possible reward from [[Bounty#Deepmines Bounties|Deepmines Bounties]] from [[Nightcap]].
*Purchaseable from [[Nightcap]] in [[Fortuna]] for 10 {{Resource|Fergolyte}} each, with a total of 210 for max rank.}}

==Notes==
*At every rank, it will take '''40''' {{D|Cold}} procs to reach the maximum bonus.
*Stacking the Frostbite buff does '''not''' require the {{D|Cold}} proc to come from the attached primary weapon. It can come from any source, even while the primary is holstered, including:
**''Any'' weapon with modded or innate {{D|Cold}} damage and status chance
**Warframe abilities including the following:
***Warframes with abilities that directly inflict {{D|Cold}} status effects, such as {{WF|Frost}}, {{WF|Yareli}}, {{WF|Gauss}} and {{WF|Narin}}
***Warframes with {{D|Cold}}-moddable [[Exalted Weapon|Exalted Weapons]], such as {{WF|Cyte-09}}, {{WF|Temple}}, and {{WF|Ivara}} and others
***Warframes which have received [[#Subsumable_Ability_Checklist|subsume abilities]] from the [[Helminth]] that can inflict {{D|Cold}} including:
**** {{A|Ice Wave}} from {{WF|Frost}}
**** {{A|Vial Rush}} from {{WF|Lavos}}
**** {{A|Thermal Sunder}} from {{WF|Gauss}}
***Warframes with abilities that apply many status effects, such as {{WF|Citrine}}, {{WF|Koumei}} and {{WF|Voruna}}
***Warframes with variable-element configurations, such as {{WF|Lavos}} and {{WF|Chroma}}
***Warframes that make {{D|Cold}}-inflicting traps, such as {{WF|Follie}} and {{WF|Mirage}}
**Performing a [[Maneuvers#Rolling|dodge-roll]] with {{Arcane|Melee Careen}} creates 1 stack of Frostbite per enemy [[Cold_Damage#General|frozen]]
**Any {{D|Cold}} status procs inflicted by Companion via modded weapons and abilities, such {{M|Coolant Leak}} and {{M|Aerial Bond}}
*{{M|Ice Spring}} does not stack Frostbite, despite inflicting a {{D|Cold}} status proc.
**Neither does the blast wave reload effect from {{Weapon|Aksondol}}.
*Though some enemies have a capped number of status effects they can receive, such as [[Bosses]] and [[Adversary System|Adversaries]] (usually capped at 4 stacks), applying a {{D|Cold}} proc to a non-[[Damage/Cold_Damage#General|Frozen]] enemy at max procs will still cause Frostbite to refresh and stack.
**However, fully [[Damage/Cold_Damage#General|Frozen]] enemies (10 stacks of {{D|Cold}}) cannot receive a new Cold proc, and do not have any interaction with Frostbite until the 3-second Freeze wears off. 
*Stacks are granted and refreshed even on fatal damage instances that apply {{D|Cold}}.  
*If Primary Frostbite is equipped on multiple weapons simultaneously, as is possible with [[Exalted Weapons]] and [[Archgun|Archguns]], they will all share the same buff.
* If the '''12''' second timer expires without applying a fresh {{D|Cold}} status effect, all stacks are removed.
** This behavior is consistent with other weapon arcanes that trigger on status effect application, like {{Arcane|Primary Blight}} and {{Arcane|Cascadia Flare}}.
** This is distinct from weapon arcanes that trigger on kill, like {{Arcane|Primary Merciless}} and {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}}, where timer expiration causes only one stack to be removed at a time. 
*At Rank 5 with maximum stacks, Primary Frostbite gives the same stat bonus as {{M|Vital Sense}} and {{M|Split Chamber}} combined.
*{{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, a primary weapon arcane with similar effects except triggered by {{D|Toxin}}, can be compared to Frostbite, and both weapon arcanes yield very effective damage boosts with only slight differences.
**{{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}}, triggering on {{D|Cold}}, offers a maximum 120% Critical Damage and 90% Multishot, prioritizing [[Multishot]].
**{{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, triggering from {{D|Toxin}}, offers a maximum 144% Critical Damage and 72% Multishot, prioritizing [[Critical Damage]].
***However, {{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}} has advantages over {{Arcane|Primary Blight}}, since the Frostbite buff can be stacked with {{D|Cold}} status effects from any source, whereas {{Arcane|Primary Blight}} can only be stacked from primary weapon {{D|Toxin}} status effects.

==Tips==
*With high [[fire rate]] weapons such as {{Weapon|Glaxion}} ({{Weapon|Glaxion Vandal|Vandal}}, {{Weapon|Tenet Glaxion|Tenet}}), {{Weapon|Verglas}}, or {{Weapon|Tazicor}}, Primary Frostbite's max stack can be reached quickly.
*{{WF|Lavos}} ability {{A|Vial Rush}} and {{A|Transmutation Probe}} is an effective way to get this arcane to max stacks quickly, as those abilities proc repeatedly over time and cover a large area.
*Effects that passively inflict {{D|Cold}} status procs on enemies in an AoE around the player are helpful for acquiring and keeping stacks, such as {{Arcane|Melee Careen}}, {{M|Aerial Bond}}, and {{M|Coolant Leak}}.
**In particular {{M|Coolant Leak}} applies {{D|Cold}} in a radius on a 10-second cooldown, allowing for persistent upkeep of Frostbite's 12-second buff so long as enemies are nearby.

==Bugs==
*If installed in the primary arcane slot of an [[Archgun]] equipped in the [[Archgun#Atmospheric|Heavy Weapon]] slot (on the third page of the Arsenal screen, below Gear and Emotes wheels), applying {{D|Cold}} status effects will cause the buff icon to appear even while that weapon is not equipped. 
**However, the effects are not applied to any weapon unless {{Arcane|Primary Frostbite}} is installed in that weapon's active arcane slot.
*Primary Frostbite doesn't work with {{M|Shivering Contagion}}.

{{ArcaneBox}} '''Primary Plated Round''' is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for primary weapons that increases primary weapon [[damage]] for a short duration when reloading a depleted [[magazine]] from the equipped primary weapon. ==Effect== {| class="emodtable" |- ! Rank !! Duration |- | 0 || 3s |- | 1 || 4s |- | 2 || 5s |- | 3 || 6s |- | 4 || 8s |- | 5 || 10s |} {{Acquisition|Primary Plated Round can be obtained from [[Mirror Defense]] as a [[Rotation]] B reward. Alternatively it can be purchased from [[Otak]] for 60 {{Resource|Belric Crystal Fragment}} and {{Resource|Rania Crystal Fragment}} each, for a total of 1,260 of each for max rank.}} ==Damage Bonus== Maximum damage bonus on a full reload is:
'''\text{Max Damage Bonus} = 15 \cdot \sqrt{5 \cdot \text{Magazine Size}}''' When a partial reload occurs, the partial bonus is:
'''\text{Partial Damage Bonus} = \frac{\text{(Magazine Size - Leftover Ammunition)}}\text{(Magazine Size)} \cdot 15 \cdot \sqrt{5 \cdot \text{Magazine Size}}''' This bonus is additive to base damage sources such as {{M|Serration}}. The "Ideal [[Fire Rate]]" below refers to how quickly a weapon must fire for a 10s bonus to last for its entire next magazine, assuming the trigger is held continuously. Double the amount shown for most [[Continuous Weapon|continuous]] weapons, which consume ammo differently. {| class="wikitable" |+ Damage Increase |- ! Magazine !! Bonus !! Ideal Fire Rate !! Notes |- | 1 || 33.54% || 0.10 || |- | 5 || 75.00% || 0.50 || |- | 7 || 88.74% || 0.70 || Almost matches either {{M|Point Blank}} or {{M|Vicious Spread}} at max rank. |- | 9 || 100.62% || 0.90 || |- | 20 || 150.00% || 2.00 || |- | 25 || 167.71% || 2.50 || Matches either {{M|Serration}}, {{M|Heavy Caliber}}, or {{M|Primed Point Blank}} at max rank. |- | 36 || 201.25% || 3.60 || |- | 80 || 300.00% || 8.00 || Matches {{Arcane|Arcane Primary Charger}} at max rank. |- | 116 || 361.25% || 11.60 || Matches {{Arcane|Primary Deadhead}}, {{Arcane|Primary Dexterity|Dexterity}} and {{Arcane|Primary Merciless|Merciless}} at max rank |- | 200 || 474.34% || 20.00 || |- | 250 || 530.33% || 25.00 || |- | 300 || 580.95% || 30.00 || |} ==Notes== *Only activates upon '''refilling''' of the '''primary''' weapon magazine. **Some reloads replenish their magazine ''before'' the reload time is finished, where the arcane may prematurely activate. For example {{Weapon|Prisma Gorgon}} refills at ~4/5 of its reload time, where it may lose about 0.5 seconds of the arcane's duration before it can even fire. *Cannot activate off of weapons with [[Battery Weapon|battery magazines]] such as {{Weapon|Flux Rifle}}, {{Weapon|Bubonico}} or [[Kitgun]]s equipped with {{Arcane|Pax Charge}}. *The partial reload multiplier has directly linear scaling and the magazine size bonus scales logarithmically (lower than directly linear), meaning that reloading a given amount of ammunition will give a better bonus when it is near the magazine size. **For example, reloading a completely empty 40-round magazine will grant a 212% bonus, but reloading 40 rounds into an 80-round magazine will only grant a 150% bonus, and reloading 40 rounds into a 120-round magazine grants only a 122% bonus. *Mods such as [[Tactical Reload]] and [[Set Mods#Synth Mod Set|Synth Mods]] will cause this arcane to lose most of its effect if the weapon gets holstered, because they are coded as frequent single-round reloads, and will continually overwrite any existing Plated Round buffs with very small partial reload buffs until the magazine is full. *Can be equipped on [[Bow]]s, but will not have any effect, as they do not reload. *Transforming an [[Incarnon]] weapon into Incarnon Form triggers this arcane, because that transformation performs a simultaneous reload of the weapon's base magazine. **The bonus granted after an Incarnon transformation scales with size of the base magazine and the amount of ammunition reloaded into it, not the number of Incarnon Charges. ==Tips== *Unlike other Arcanes that require hitting or killing a live target to trigger, Primary Plated Round's activation is entirely within the player's control, meaning it can be prepared in advance of difficult engagements such as boss fights. *Picking up {{WF|Cyte-09|Cyte-09's}} {{A|Resupply}} ammo packs triggers Primary Plated Round. *Reloading via {{WF|Garuda}}'s {{M|Blood Forge}} triggers Primary Plated Round. *Performs best on weapons with above-average magazine sizes (120 rounds or more) that also consume the magazine quickly enough to benefit from the bonus during its 10-second duration. This strategy takes a heavy toll on a weapon's ammunition, though, so ammo pickups should be considered. **See [[Weapon Comparison/Primary]] for a complete list of primary weapons, sortable by magazine size. **[[Ammo Mutation Mods|Ammo Mutation]] and [[Ammo#Increasing Ammo From Pickups|Scavenger]] mods are often helpful, as is {{M|Ammo Case}}. Abilities such as {{A|Dispensary}} (which can be transferred via the [[Helminth]]) or {{A|Resupply}} are also beneficial. **{{Weapon|Kohm}} (with 245 rounds) and {{Weapon|Kuva Kohm}} (with 209 rounds) have only average fire rates (roughly 3.67 and 4.17 respectively when fully spooled), but consume 4 ammo per shot at full spool. Shotguns also have the strongest magazine bonus available ({{M|Primed Ammo Stock}}), but the ammo per pickup for both guns is only 40, making it difficult to sustain without using [[Squad Ammo Restore]]s or similar mechanics. **{{Weapon|Quellor}}'s primary fire mode (6.00) is slow to unload its 300-round magazine, but the [[Alternate Fire]] will consume 50 ammo per shot at a rate of 0.45 shots/sec, depleting the magazine in 13.2 seconds without modding fire rate. **Similarly, {{Weapon|Trumna}}'s 200-round magazine is hindered by its slow primary fire rate of 4.67, but can prepare a reload for a devastating alt-fire attack. **{{Weapon|Prisma Grakata}} has 120 rounds in the magazine and a very high fire rate of 21.67. {{M|Wild Frenzy}} also helps the Prisma Grakata empty out its magazine very quickly, and the damage boost from this Arcane makes it easy to trigger the augment's ammo refund. **A {{Weapon|Rattleguts|Primary Rattleguts}} kitgun with the [[Macro Arcroid]] loader (providing 153 rounds) can be crafted with either the [[Shrewd]] (14), [[Palmaris]] (15.5), or [[Brash]] (17) grips, allowing the magazine to be emptied in 10 seconds on average. *See [[Fire Rate#Sources of Fire Rate Bonus|Fire Rate]] for ways to increase weapon fire rate so that the weapon can make full use of the 10-second damage buff. ==Patch History== {{Scrollbox/Article| {{ver|32.3.6}} *Updated the description for the Primary Plated Round Arcane to be more accurate to its function. **''On Reload: Deal increased damage per round '''loaded based on max magazine size.''' Lasts for 10s.'' {{ver|32.3}} *Introduced. }} {{ArcaneNav}} [[uk:Основний заряд]] [[Category:Mirror Defense Arcanes]]

'''Primary Debilitate''' is an [[Arcane_Enhancement#Primary_Weapon_Arcanes|Primary Arcane]] that applies additional status effects when a [[Damage#Possible_Combinations|Combined Element]] status is at 10 stacks or more.

==Effect==

==Acquisition==
*Can be bought from [[Roathe]] at [[La Cathédrale]] in the [[Sanctum Anatomica]] for 5 {{Resource|Maphica}}.
*May appear as a [[Steel Path]] [[The Descendia]] reward on a weekly rotational basis.
**Infernum 6 and 13 awards 1.
**Infernum 20 awards 3.

==Notes==
* The extra [[Status Effect]] created by this arcane is applied as a separate damage instance, causing [[Faction Damage Bonus|Faction Damage Bonuses]] to multiply the [[Damage over Time]] effect of {{D|Heat}}, {{D|Electricity}}, and {{D|Toxin}} status three separate times.
* This arcane will only activate once per damage instance, making it less effective than it "should" be when used on a Beam weapon, due to how [[Multishot]] affects such weapons. 
* Will apply status effects from any source of combined elemental damage buffs, such as {{M|Gastroparesis}} allowing both the Heat and Poison status to scale infinitely.
* This ''can'' add Cold and Heat procs from a full stack of {{D|Blast}} status effects, but it triggers less often due to the 10 stack loss of blast, and is less effective than Gas or Corrosive since Cold status deals no DoT.

'''Primary Compression'''  is an [[Arcane Enhancement]] for [[Primaries]] that reduces the explosion radius of the weapon's shots by 80% while [[aiming]], while increasing the weapon's [[damage]] by 100% and [[Ammo Efficiency]] by 5.5% for every meter of radius lost.

==Effect==

! Damage per Meter
! Ammo Efficiency per Meter

|-

{{Acquisition|name=Primary Compression}}

Can be purchased from [[Hunhow]] at [[Pontis Tower]] for 15 {{Resource|Emerald Talent}} and 15 {{Resource|Crimson Talent}}.

==Notes==
*The bonuses smoothly scale between whole number radius values. For example, a loss of 6.5 meters of radius gives +650% Damage and +35.75% Ammo Efficiency with a Rank 5 arcane.
*On projectile weapons, the damage bonus is multiplicative to other damage bonus sources (e.g. {{M|Serration}}).
*Does not work on [[Continuous Weapon|Continuous Weapons]] or beam attacks with an AoE component, e.g. {{Weapon|Ignis}} or {{Weapon|Torid}}'s Incarnon Form.
*Ammo Efficiency is always granted based on radius lost, regardless of how the damage bonus functions. This includes [[Archgun|Archguns]], most of which currently gain no damage bonus or radius reduction, but do gain the Efficiency.
